title: Rehearsal and runbook: sign drafts with endorse --from
description: vouch-ey47.20 added git vouch endorse --from DRAFT. tests/migrate/rehearsal.sh and the docs/flag-day.md endorsement loop still use 'ssh-keygen -Y sign ... -n git-vouch-endorse'. Switch both, in the same change, to 'git vouch endorse --from "$f"'.
acceptance_criteria: rehearsal.sh runs green using endorse --from; flag-day.md loop matches it exactly; no remaining raw -n git-vouch-endorse signing in docs or rehearsal.
